query.label: Q1: słowo w dowolnej formie (galaxy → galaxies)

main_cat.sql: SELECT main_cat,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'galaxy')  GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY main_cat COLLATE "C"

sub_cat.sql: SELECT sub_cat,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'galaxy')  GROUP BY sub_cat ORDER BY sub_cat COLLATE "C"

year.sql: SELECT 1990+((year-1990)/5)*5 AS bucket,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'galaxy')  AND year >= 1990 AND year < 2030 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

sql_combined.sql: WITH matches AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT main_cat,sub_cat,1990+((year-1990)/5)*5 AS bucket FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE tsv @@ to_tsquery('english', 'galaxy') ) SELECT main_cat,sub_cat,bucket,count(*) FROM matches GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((main_cat),(sub_cat),(bucket)) ORDER BY main_cat NULLS FIRST,sub_cat NULLS FIRST,bucket NULLS FIRST

main_cat.sql: SELECT main_cat,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE TRUE GROUP BY main_cat ORDER BY main_cat COLLATE "C"

sub_cat.sql: SELECT sub_cat,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE TRUE GROUP BY sub_cat ORDER BY sub_cat COLLATE "C"

year.sql: SELECT 1990+((year-1990)/5)*5 AS bucket,count(*) FROM grade5_arxiv WHERE TRUE AND year >= 1990 AND year < 2030 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
